jobs.name: Oil & filter change
jobs.notes:
- 0W-20 full synthetic, 3.7 qt
- 17 mm drain plug, 29 ft-lb
- New crush washer every time
- Reset the maintenance minder afterwards

jobs.name: Tire rotation
jobs.notes:
- Front to back, no side swap
- Torque lugs to 80 ft-lb
- Check pressure after

jobs.name: Check tire pressure
jobs.notes:
- 35 psi cold, front and rear
- Don't forget the spare

jobs.name: Oil change
jobs.notes:
- SAE 30, 15 oz
- Tip it air-filter side up
- Run it dry of fuel first

jobs.name: Winterize
jobs.notes:
- Fuel stabilizer, then run 5 min
- Clean the deck
